nodes.cached_ticket_title: Startup artifact pollution: MCP servers/viewers must not create stores or log dirs on mere startup in storeless workspaces

objective: Implement and execute the storeless-workspace startup matrix, identify every startup artifact creator, remove eager filesystem writes, and prove all eight acceptance criteria.

target_tickets.why: All eight startup-pollution acceptance criteria remain unimplemented and unvalidated after review.
acceptance_criteria: Create a reusable fresh storeless-workspace fixture.
Parameterize startup across the discovered installed MCP server/viewer matrix.
Assert zero filesystem delta for unconfigured read-only startup.
Return clear non-mutating errors when an operation requires a missing store.
Prove explicit initialization and configured first writes still create intended artifacts.
Identify the exact creator of test-logs/ or target/test-logs/.
Provide a repository-level startup matrix command.

higher_level_objective: Ensure MCP servers and viewers are side-effect free on startup in storeless workspaces while preserving explicit initialization and configured write behavior.
decisions: Implement the validation matrix before changing production startup behavior.
Persistent stores require explicit initialization or configuration; startup alone must not create stores.
Filesystem logging remains disabled without an explicit destination.
Generated log directories are created lazily on the first configured write.
Use exact before/after filesystem snapshots with exit status, stdout, and stderr per matrix entry.
Keep fa2ba34b linked but non-blocking; do not add a depends_on edge.
Review failed all eight criteria because the submitted commits contain planning/spec/handoff metadata only.
Validation vt-storeless-startup-matrix is blocked and has no execution evidence.
WIP commit was declined; iteration metadata remains dirty.
non_goals: Do not broaden the work into session-anchored workspace resolution.
Do not create stores or log directories merely to simplify startup probing.
Do not change production behavior before the failing matrix identifies the creator paths.
risk_notes: The matrix spans multiple installed binaries and may expose more than one artifact-producing startup path. Preserve exact storeless-workspace snapshots and separate startup effects from explicit operation effects.
